# Gallery

Hereby are examples of flow maps made with Arabesque, sorted by main topic.

## **Sustainable Development and adaptation to climate change**

### Food supply network (short food delivery from Logicout)

Short food delivery rounds declared by users of the [Logicout](https://logicout.fr/couts/) online application, enabling the cost and carbon impact of short-distance deliveries to be calculated).

Geography of short food circuits declared in the Logicout database in 2024.

![](images/Example_logicout_all_places_map_Bahoken.png)

Short food circuits declared in euros in the Logicout database in 2024.

![](images/Example_logicout_rounds_in_euros_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Françoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2024. \
**Note:** Flow maps layout in drawing software.

**Data source:** [Logicout](https://logicout.fr/couts/) database, Univ. Gustave Eiffel and Cerema. Data compiled by Nicolas Roelandt, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, 2024.

**Based map:** Open Street Map contributors.

**References:** Gwenaëlle Raton, [Logicout, présentation](https://splott.univ-gustave-eiffel.fr/la-recherche/logicout), Univ. Gustave Eiffel, Département Aménagement, mobilités, environnement. (AME), laboratoire Splott.

### Tree species and climate conditions scientific collaborations

Tree species and climate conditions topic collaborations over to nine publications in 2024, between cities 5,000 kilometers away from each other.

![](images/Example_scientific_collaborations_tree_species_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

Tree species and climate conditions topic collaborations over to nine publications in 2024, between cities 5,000 to 12,000 kilometers away from each other.

![](images/Example_scientific_collaborations_tree_species_5-12kkm_map_Bahoken.png)

Tree species and climate conditions topic collaborations over to five publications in 2024, between the cities of the Gulf of Guinea.

![](images/Example_scientific_collaborations_tree_species_Gulf_Guinee_map_Bahoken-01.png)

**Flow mapping:** Françoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2025.

**Data source:** Web of Sciences (WOS), International scientific collaborations on the theme "Tree species and climates conditions". Data compiled by Lionel Villard (Univ. Gustave Eiffel) and Étienne Côme (Univ. Gustave Eiffel).

**Based map:** Stamen Terrain, with equidistant conic cartographic projection.

**References:** RETICULAR program, Univ. Gustave Eiffel. 2025. Made with CorText Manager and Arabesque.

### Temperature topic scientific collaborations

Urban heat island and air temperature topic collaborations between cities in 2021.

![](images/Example_scientific_collaborations_urban_heat_island_map_Bahoken_Come_Villard.png)

**Flow mapping:** Françoise Bahoken, Etienne Côme and Lionel Villard (Univ. Gustave Eiffel)

**Data source:** Web of Sciences (WOS), International scientific collaborations on the theme "Climate changes in urban areas".

**Based map:** ESRI World topographic map.

**References:** RETICULAR program, Univ. Gustave Eiffel. 2025.

## **Human mobilities**

### African migrants in malaria endemic countries

Estimated internal human migrants flows from 2005 to 2010 between sub-national administrative units for malaria endemic countries.

![](images/Example_african_migrants_malaria_zones_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Françoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2025.\
**Note:** Flow map layout in drawing software.

**Data source:** Estimated internal human migration flows between subnational administrative units for malaria endemic countries (WHO, 2015). See [Documentation](http://www.who.int/malaria/publications/country-profiles/en/). [Data Descriptor](https://www.nature.com/articles/sdata201666.pdf). Sorichetta A. *et al*. Mapping internal connectivity through human migration in malaria endemic countries. Sci Data 3, 160066 (2016). https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.66

**Based map:** ESRI World imagery.

**References:** Françoise Bahoken (5 mai 2025). [Flux de migrants en zone endémique paludéenne](https://doi.org/10.58079/13v61) (2016). *Carnet (neo)cartographique*. Sorichetta, A., Bird, T., Ruktanonchai, N. et al. Mapping internal connectivity through human migration in malaria endemic countries. Sci Data 3, 160066 (2016). https://doi.org/10.1038/sdata.2016.66

### Covid 2020 french migration

Inter french department post covid migrations over than 800 people and less than 200 kilometers.

![](images/Example_post_covid_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Francoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel, 2020.

**Data source:** Bouygues Telecom, Orange Business Services France, SFR and INSEE, 2020. See [documentation](https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/4635407#documentation)

**Based map:** CARTO database voyager labeled.

**References:** Galiana, L., Suarez Castillo, M., Sémécurbe, F. Coudin, E., de Bellefon, M.-P. (2020), "Retour partiel des mouvements de population avec le déconfinement", Insee Analyses N°54, INSEE.

### Summer car-sharing in France in 2022

Number of carpooling journeys made in France in August 2022 (450,000 movements between 7,800 municipalities).

![](images/Example_car_sharing_France_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Francoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2023.

**Data source:** Registre de preuve du covoiturage, 2022. See [//covoiturage.beta.gouv.fr](https://covoiturage.beta.gouv.fr/)

**Based map:** Open Street Map contributors.

**References:** Françoise Bahoken, *Arabesque*, Journée d'étude :"La boite à outils de cartographie et de géovisualisation de données. Regards croisés de chercheurs ([JE Rennes](https://github.com/magisAR9/JEGeovizRennes)), Action de recherche n°9 (Carto)graphies et (géo)visualisation de données, GdR CNRS MAGIS, Rennes, 2023.

### School mobility in France

School mobility in 2021: all journeys between home and place of study, aggregated by departments.

![](images/Example_scholarmobility_map_Bahoken.png)

School mobility in 2021 between home and place of study less than 200 kilometers.

![](images/Example_mobscol_less_than_200km_map_Bahoken.PNG){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Francoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2025.

**Data source:** French Population Census - Mobility flows database. School mobility (MOBSCOL), INSEE, 2020. See [Documentation](https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8201894).

**Based map:** Open Street Map contributors.

### Domestic passengers flows in France in 2019

Total number of passengers between French airports in 2019 : local passengers and transit passengers, without double counting.

![](images/Example_domestic_air_passengers_total_2019_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Françoise Bahoken, 2025

**Data source:** Étienne Côme and Laurent Jégou (*gflowiz team)* for the Cartomob international conference's mapathon, 2020. Direction générale de l'aviation civile (2020), *Bulletin statistique : trafic aérien commercial année 2019*, Ministère de la transition écologique et solidaire MTES, Eurostats (2020), *Transport database*. See [Documentation](https://cartomob.sciencesconf.org/resource/page/id/16.html?lang=fr).

**Based map:** Stadia Stamen dark.

**References:** *gflowiz team,* [Cartomob international conference mapathon](https://github.com/gflowiz/mapathon/tree/master), 2020.

### International refugees in 2017

Refugees and internally displaced persons in 2017. Migrants flows of more than 10,000 people and less than 5,000 kilometers.

![](images/Example_international_refugees_in_2015_map_Bahoken.png)

**Flow mapping:** Francoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2025.

**Data source:** United Nations, UNHCR. 2015

**Based map:** ESRI World topographic map.

### International migration stock

![](images/Example_international_migrants_map_Bahoken.png)

**Flow mapping:** Francoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2023.

## **Animal migrations**

### European birds migration

Nocturnal bird migration (one particular night) based on data from the European network of weather radars.

![](images/Example_birds_migration_map_Bahoken.png){fig-align="left"}

**Flow mapping:** Françoise Bahoken (Univ. Gustave Eiffel), 2025.

**Data source:** Raphaël Nussbaumer, [Bird migration modelling (BMM)](https://birdmigrationmap.vogelwarte.ch/), 2018.

**Based map:** CARTO Database with no labels.

**References:** Raphaël Nussbaumer,Silke Bauer, Lionel Benoit, Grégoire Mariethoz, Felix Liechti and Baptiste Schmid (2021), Quantifying year-round nocturnal bird migration with a fluid dynamics model, Royal Society Publishing. <https://doi.org/10.1098/rsif.2021.0194>
